scope: Targeted Friday/Saturday QB and key-player news, not an exhaustive all-player injury list.
caveat: News is context only, not a point adjustment. v2.2 availability remains null. Reports can change before kickoff.

401858254.text: Thursday report: Louisville QB Lincoln Kienholz probable. FSU DL Darryll Desir upgraded to probable; FSU lists 10 out and Louisville 8 out. Louisville RB Keyjuan Brown, OL Cason Henry and DL Daylen Russell questionable.
401858254.source_date: Oct 8, 8 PM ET, official ACC Thursday report

401858487.text: Iowa QB Hank Brown (shoulder) questionable. Ferentz says the current plan is Jeremy Hecklinski with Jimmy Sullivan next; final Brown decision not confirmed.

401856826.text: BYU RB LJ Martin and LB Isaiah Glasker out on initial report; RB Sione Moa also out. Iowa State S Drew Surges, DE Caden Crawford and DT Ka'Mori Moore out. Later game-day report may change availability.

401860922.text: WSU coach Kirby Moore taking over offensive playcalling. Friday starting QB remains unresolved in this report: Caden Pinnick, Owen Eshelman or Julian Dugger.

401858256.text: Pitt confirms Mason Heintschel out for season with torn ACL; Holden Geriner named starter, Corey Dailey backup.

401856713.text: Thursday: QB Faizon Brandon questionable. George MacIntyre expected to start per reporting; Heupel has not publicly detailed the plan.

401858259.text: Official Thursday 11 PM ET report: Cal QB Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele, RB Adam Mohammed, WR Chase Hendricks and S Kingston Lopa questionable. RB Carter Vargas and DL Nate Burrell out. Not a final game-day report.

401858484.text: Oregon QB Dante Moore out in concussion protocol; Dylan Raiola to start against UCLA. Returning to practice did not mean cleared to play.

401856716.text: Thursday: Texas A&M WR Mario Craver questionable; WR Terry Bussey and OL Blake Ivy out. Missouri OL Cayden Green and six other Tigers questionable.

401856717.text: Thursday: Oklahoma LB Cole Sullivan, S Michael Boganowski, WR Jer'Michael Carter and TE Jack Van Dorselaer upgraded to probable. OL Michael Fasusi doubtful; OL Eddy Pierre-Louis questionable.

401856712.text: Wednesday report: Alabama TE Josh Ford and DB Jorden Edmonds questionable; LB Justin Hill and Desmond Umeozulu out. Georgia WR Isiah Canion questionable. Source has an inconsistent kickoff date, so this is labeled Wednesday-only, not final.

401858260.text: Official Thursday: NC State RB Jayden Scott out, along with 10 other Wolfpack players. Wake Forest OL Jack Hines questionable.

401858258.text: Official Thursday: Syracuse QB Amari Odom questionable; Virginia lists 15 out. Not a final game-day report.
